dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It sounds like you're the one who needs help, really.

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: To be honest, I think I've accepted that my work simply cannot be finished.

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: After all, that Goldman — that is, my boss — is one of those... "calculative" people.

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: That's how I often find myself here, busy dealing with divesuits that could possibly stop working, or something like that...

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: Not to mention the stuff deep underwater, and those waterweeds and detritus that seem to think my job is far too easy...

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: ...Oh, I've started complaining again, haven't I? Sorry about that. Anyway, thanks for your concern.
